Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/15] The data set has a 3-level nested structure: time points at level 1, migrants at level 2, and country of origin at level 3. MLwiN Version 2.1 (Rasbash et al., 2009) was used for all analyses. As typical in model testing approaches, predictions are tested by comparing the relative fit of the two nested models. When the new predictor significantly reduces the model's -2 \times \log likelihood ratio (LR) this will be taken as supportive evidence for the predicted association between the predictor and MLS.
